description: A long deep plum tailored outer coat with narrow gold floral woven borders down the front edges, around the cuffs and hem, over a cream linen tunic with a high rounded split neckline and restrained gold trim. An ornamented brown-and-gold belt has a broad round metal buckle and decorated hanging strap. Dark trousers and tall brown leather boots are visible; sleeves cover the arms to the wrists. No headgear, armor or weapons are present.
